reason: Use a Tier 2 representation change: replace uniform prefix pooling with jointly learned, exponentially decayed prefix memory. Uniform pooling reached 0.5325 without exceeding the reported 0.5387 reference, while hard-negative weighting reduced performance to 0.4912, supporting retention of balanced BCE. Equal weighting of old and recent purchases may dilute current interests; learned temporal decay tests this hypothesis through one controlled architectural change.

plan.model_design: Replace the uniform cumulative mean inside ConvRec._prefix_mean with normalized exponential pooling controlled by one jointly trained scalar memory_decay_logit, initialized so sigmoid(memory_decay_logit)=0.9. For each nonpadding position, update numerator = decay * numerator + embedding and denominator = decay * denominator + 1, returning numerator / denominator.clamp_min(1e-8); padding must leave both states unchanged and produce zero output. This lets the existing gated memory emphasize recent interests while remaining causal and normalized across history lengths. Preserve _prefix_mean(embeddings, mask), ConvRec's constructor, forward, predict, ranking_loss, memory_projection, memory_gate, tied item_emb, item_bias, convolution blocks, uniform balanced BCE, NEGATIVES=256, TOKEN_LIMIT=2048, and all other settings.
plan.training_evaluation: Treat learned memory decay as the sole experimental change relative to the supplied 0.5325 pooled balanced-BCE implementation, retaining PrefixDataset, optimizer, schedule, training seed 42, fixed validation candidates, checkpoint cadence, and early stopping. Update write_predict_script and strict checkpoint reconstruction to load memory_decay_logit, and verify causal prefix invariance, padding invariance, finite decay gradients, and agreement between model.predict and exported predictor scores. Select and reload exactly one checkpoint per category using validation HR@10, report category scores and their macro-average, and compare the authoritative host result against 0.5325 and the reported 0.5387 best without assuming improvement. Preserve all four routes, DATA_DIR=os.environ['GAGC_DATA_DIR'], supplied splits and preprocessing, SASREC_EPOCHS default 200, trial-local artifacts, single-GPU execution, and existing deadlines; leave held-out inference to the host.
